analysis: The code defines getRandomPortNumber(int min, int max) which calls nextInt(bound) with bound = max - min. According to the API documentation, nextInt throws IllegalArgumentException if bound is not positive (<=0). The method does not include any validation to ensure that max > min, so the condition for throwing IllegalArgumentException is not avoided in this calling context.
remark: The IllegalArgumentException from nextInt will be thrown if the bound (max - min) is not positive, i.e., if max <= min. The getRandomPortNumber method does not check this precondition, so the exception can occur when the caller provides invalid arguments.
